give @s snowball[minecraft:custom_name='{"text":"Fireball","color":"red","bold":true,"italic":false}',minecraft:custom_data={fireball:1b},minecraft:enchantment_glint_override=true] 16
tellraw @s {"text":"You got 16 Fireballs! Throw them at monsters. 🔥","color":"gold"}

tellraw @s ["",{"text":"🔥 Fireball pack loaded! ","color":"gold","bold":true},{"text":"[ Click here for Fireballs ]","color":"red","bold":true,"underlined":true,"clickEvent":{"action":"run_command","value":"/function fireball:give"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Get 16 Mario-style fireballs","color":"yellow"}}}]
tellraw @s {"text":"(or type this yourself: /function fireball:give )","color":"gray","italic":true}

data modify storage fireball:global args set value {}
data modify storage fireball stack set value []
gamerule maxCommandChainLength 1000000000
execute as @a run function fireball:greet

# Greet each player once. A load-time tellraw @a reaches NOBODY in singleplayer,
# because the pack loads a beat before the player finishes joining the world.
execute as @a[tag=!fireball_greeted] run function fireball:line033/execute1
# A thrown Fireball snowball carries our custom_data. Tag it 'fb' once so the
# block below can act on it every tick. (NBT match lives in a raw command so we
# don't lean on the selector parser for deep component paths.)
execute as @e[type=minecraft:snowball,tag=!fb,nbt={Item:{components:{"minecraft:custom_data":{fireball:1b}}}}] run tag @s add fb
execute as @e[type=minecraft:snowball,tag=fb] at @s run function fireball:line043/execute2

# The Mario look: a little jet of flame and smoke trailing the fireball.
particle minecraft:flame ~ ~ ~ 0.15 0.15 0.15 0.02 12 force
particle minecraft:smoke ~ ~ ~ 0.1 0.1 0.1 0.01 4
# Anything it touches (within ~1.8 blocks) catches fire and takes damage.
# Excludes the snowball itself, dropped items, players and XP orbs. Both run
# per-entity via 'execute as' because /damage only accepts a SINGLE target.
execute as @e[distance=..1.8,type=!minecraft:snowball,type=!minecraft:item,type=!minecraft:player,type=!minecraft:experience_orb] run data merge entity @s {Fire:100s}
execute as @e[distance=..1.8,type=!minecraft:snowball,type=!minecraft:item,type=!minecraft:player,type=!minecraft:experience_orb] run damage @s 4 minecraft:on_fire
